## Overview

This SQL database was created for an exam. 
It involved designing and implementing a relational database for a hotel reservation system 
called Bookify. The database was built using SQL and covers core operations such as managing guests, 
rooms, and reservations. It demonstrates the use of table creation, data insertion, 
joins, and aggregate functions. 

## Database Setup

The database was created and three core tables were defined — Guest, Room, and Reservation. 
Foreign keys were used to link reservations to both guests and rooms.

```sql
CREATE DATABASE BookifyDB0;

CREATE TABLE Guest (
    Guest_ID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    Full_name VARCHAR(30),
    Email VARCHAR(30)
);

CREATE TABLE Room (
    Room_ID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    Price FLOAT,
    typeroom VARCHAR(10)
);

CREATE TABLE Reservation (
    Reservation_ID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    Guest_ID INT,
    Room_ID INT,
    NO_of_Guest INT,
    Reservation_date DATE,
    FOREIGN KEY (Guest_ID) REFERENCES Guest (Guest_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Room_ID) REFERENCES Room (Room_ID)
);
```

Sample data was inserted into each table to populate the database for querying.

```sql
INSERT INTO Guest (Guest_ID, Full_name, Email) VALUES

(103, 100, 'Double'),
(104, 150, 'Single');

INSERT INTO Reservation (Reservation_ID, Guest_ID, Room_ID, NO_of_Guest, Reservation_date) VALUES
(1, 1, 101, 1, '2025-11-15'),
(2, 1, 101, 1, '2025-11-16'),

```

## Queries

### Retrieve All Room Types

```sql
SELECT typeroom FROM Room;
```

### Reservations Ordered by Date

```sql
SELECT Reservation_date FROM Reservation 
ORDER BY Reservation_date DESC;
```

### Add New Guests

```sql
INSERT INTO Guest (Guest_ID, Full_name, Email) VALUES
(4, 'Ewan Connolly', 'e.c@mail.com'),
(5, 'Maya Evans', 'm.e@mail.com');
```

### Add New Reservation

```sql
INSERT INTO Reservation (Reservation_ID, Guest_ID, Room_ID, NO_of_Guest, Reservation_date) VALUES
(6, 4, 104, 1, '2025-11-26');
```

### Update a Reservation Date

```sql
UPDATE Reservation
SET Reservation_date = '2025-11-13'
WHERE Guest_ID = 3;
```

### Average Room Price

```sql
SELECT AVG(Price) FROM Room;
```

### Rooms Priced Above €110

```sql
SELECT Room_ID, Price, typeroom FROM Room
WHERE Price > 110;
```

### Guests with Reservations on 15th November

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT(Full_Name) FROM Guest
INNER JOIN Reservation ON Guest.Guest_ID = Reservation.Guest_ID
WHERE Reservation_date = '2025-11-15';
```

### All Reservations with Guest Names

```sql
SELECT Reservation_ID, Full_Name AS Total_Reservations FROM Reservation
FULL OUTER JOIN Guest ON Reservation.Guest_ID = Guest.Guest_ID
ORDER BY Total_Reservations DESC;
```
